summary: First test iteration for Kapanış Turkish trading-signal platform. Backend: 42/43 pytest tests pass (only brute-force lock fails due to rotating ingress client IPs). Frontend: all 6 public routes load, login/logout work, all 10 panel pages render, live R/R, goalpost stop rules, macro, cost, signals detail all work.

critical.issue: Brute-force lockout ineffective behind ingress: identifier uses request.client.host which rotates between multiple proxy IPs (observed 10.208.147.136 and 10.208.147.137 in same 6-request burst), so per-IP fail counter never reaches MAX_FAILED=5. 6 wrong-password calls returned 6x 401 instead of the expected 5x401 + 429. Fix: derive real client IP from X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP header (fallback to request.client.host).

issues: Timestamps read 'Güncellendi 105 gün önce' because mock_data.NOW is pinned to 2026-06-12 while the container clock is on 2026-09-25. Cosmetic; consider using dynamic 'now' or relative offsets from live time so seeded data doesn't look stale.

Recharts warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on Signals/Backtest/Cost — chart container renders before layout settles. Non-blocking but should set explicit min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.

rca of the issue: The FastAPI backend sits behind the Kubernetes ingress. `request.client.host` reports the ingress proxy's pod IP, not the actual client. The cluster load-balancer distributes even sequential requests across multiple ingress replicas (observed 10.208.147.136 and 10.208.147.137 in the same burst), so the per-IP counter in the `login_attempts` collection is split into different documents. Consequently no single identifier reaches 5 failures and the 429 lock never triggers. Reproduction: `for i in {1..6}; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -X POST $URL/api/auth/login -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"email":"x@x.io","password":"x"}'; done` returns six 401s. Mitigation: use `request.headers.get('x-forwarded-for', request.client.host).split(',')[0].strip()` as the IP source (add trust-proxy config as appropriate).
